limitations: Texture and material creation is graph-level; no visual, shader-compile, Lumen or packaged acceptance is established by this script.

Assignment is at the StaticMesh asset level: the protected Courtyard and L_FutureMount maps also reference these meshes and will render with the new materials although their .umap bytes stay unchanged.
Per-building variation is a hash of the per-building vertex colour and the 100 m bucket position; it is illustrative and not a survey of Jerusalem facades.
Normal-map handedness (nor_dx, V = +axis) is reasoned, not visually verified; NormalGreenSign in the HLSL flips it if the raking light reads inverted.
Poly Haven CC0 sets are photographic surfaces from other places (sandstone, cobbles, asphalt); they stand in for Jerusalem limestone, not document it.
